-- ONEMS Carrier Link: extraction query of one delivery (postgresql).
-- Connector: SimPost - simulated connector (carrier SIMPOST).
-- Built from GET /config: products, agreed points, field names and period. Ask GET /query again before each
-- delivery: the period changes every time and the configuration may change.
-- 1. Replace carrier_scans with your table (or view) of scans: one row per scan.
-- 2. The column event_ts is assumed a date/time WITHOUT time zone, in Africa/Nairobi. If it already
--    carries a time zone, drop the first time-zone conversion in local_date; if it is text, convert it first.
-- 3. Period: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-04 (next_period).
-- Statement 1 gives the file rows (all the scans of the complete shipments); statement 2 the control totals.

-- Statement 1: the delivery file
WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-11-02' AS p_start, DATE '2026-11-04' AS p_end
),
agreed_points AS (
  SELECT CAST('EMR-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('ACC' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('origin' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('EMR-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('DLV' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('destination' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('NPT-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('ACC' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('origin' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('NPT-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('DLV' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('destination' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('SVL-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('ACC' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('origin' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('SVL-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('DLV' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('destination' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
),
plan_products AS (
  SELECT CAST('STD' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS code
),
s AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         c."tracking_no" AS cl_item,
         c."event_ts" AS cl_ts,
         CAST((c."event_ts" AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Nairobi') AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Nairobi' AS DATE) AS cl_local_date,
         NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."service" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AS cl_product,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreed_points p WHERE p.place_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."site_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AND (p.mode_ref IS NULL OR p.mode_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."event_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '')) AND p.role IN ('destination', 'both')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_arrival,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreed_points p WHERE p.place_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."site_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AND (p.mode_ref IS NULL OR p.mode_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."event_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '')) AND p.role IN ('origin', 'both')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_departure,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreed_points p WHERE p.place_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."site_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AND (p.mode_ref IS NULL OR p.mode_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."event_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), ''))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_agreed
    FROM carrier_scans c
),
arrival AS (            -- the final arrival: the latest arrival scan of each shipment
  SELECT x.* FROM (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cl_item ORDER BY s.cl_ts DESC) AS cl_rn
                    FROM s WHERE s.is_arrival = 1 AND s.cl_ts IS NOT NULL) x
   WHERE x.cl_rn = 1
),
product AS (            -- the shipment's product: the one on its earliest scan with a time
  SELECT x.cl_item, x.cl_product FROM (SELECT s.cl_item, s.cl_product,
                                     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cl_item ORDER BY s.cl_ts) AS cl_rn
                                FROM s WHERE s.cl_ts IS NOT NULL) x
   WHERE x.cl_rn = 1
),
complete AS (           -- complete shipments of the period
  SELECT a.cl_item, a.cl_ts AS cl_arrival_ts,
         a."site_code" AS cl_arrival_place, a."event_code" AS cl_arrival_mode,
         pr.cl_product AS cl_shipment_product
    FROM arrival a
    JOIN product pr ON pr.cl_item = a.cl_item
    CROSS JOIN params
   WHERE a.cl_local_date BETWEEN params.p_start AND params.p_end
     AND pr.cl_product IN (SELECT code FROM plan_products)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s d WHERE d.cl_item = a.cl_item AND d.is_departure = 1 AND d.cl_ts < a.cl_ts)
)
SELECT s."tracking_no" AS "tracking_no", s."service" AS "service", s."event_ts" AS "event_ts", s."site_code" AS "site_code", s."event_code" AS "event_code", s."weight_g" AS "weight_g"
  FROM s JOIN complete k ON k.cl_item = s.cl_item
 WHERE s.is_agreed = 1
 ORDER BY s.cl_item, s.cl_ts;

-- Statement 2: control totals
WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-11-02' AS p_start, DATE '2026-11-04' AS p_end
),
agreed_points AS (
  SELECT CAST('EMR-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('ACC' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('origin' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('EMR-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('DLV' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('destination' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('NPT-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('ACC' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('origin' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('NPT-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('DLV' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('destination' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('SVL-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('ACC' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('origin' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
    UNION ALL SELECT CAST('SVL-PO' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS place_ref, CAST('DLV' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS mode_ref, CAST('destination' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS role
),
plan_products AS (
  SELECT CAST('STD' AS VARCHAR(400)) AS code
),
s AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         c."tracking_no" AS cl_item,
         c."event_ts" AS cl_ts,
         CAST((c."event_ts" AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Nairobi') AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Nairobi' AS DATE) AS cl_local_date,
         NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."service" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AS cl_product,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreed_points p WHERE p.place_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."site_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AND (p.mode_ref IS NULL OR p.mode_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."event_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '')) AND p.role IN ('destination', 'both')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_arrival,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreed_points p WHERE p.place_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."site_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AND (p.mode_ref IS NULL OR p.mode_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."event_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '')) AND p.role IN ('origin', 'both')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_departure,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreed_points p WHERE p.place_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."site_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), '') AND (p.mode_ref IS NULL OR p.mode_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c."event_code" AS VARCHAR(400))), ''))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_agreed
    FROM carrier_scans c
),
arrival AS (            -- the final arrival: the latest arrival scan of each shipment
  SELECT x.* FROM (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cl_item ORDER BY s.cl_ts DESC) AS cl_rn
                    FROM s WHERE s.is_arrival = 1 AND s.cl_ts IS NOT NULL) x
   WHERE x.cl_rn = 1
),
product AS (            -- the shipment's product: the one on its earliest scan with a time
  SELECT x.cl_item, x.cl_product FROM (SELECT s.cl_item, s.cl_product,
                                     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cl_item ORDER BY s.cl_ts) AS cl_rn
                                FROM s WHERE s.cl_ts IS NOT NULL) x
   WHERE x.cl_rn = 1
),
complete AS (           -- complete shipments of the period
  SELECT a.cl_item, a.cl_ts AS cl_arrival_ts,
         a."site_code" AS cl_arrival_place, a."event_code" AS cl_arrival_mode,
         pr.cl_product AS cl_shipment_product
    FROM arrival a
    JOIN product pr ON pr.cl_item = a.cl_item
    CROSS JOIN params
   WHERE a.cl_local_date BETWEEN params.p_start AND params.p_end
     AND pr.cl_product IN (SELECT code FROM plan_products)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s d WHERE d.cl_item = a.cl_item AND d.is_departure = 1 AND d.cl_ts < a.cl_ts)
)
SELECT k.cl_arrival_place AS place_ref, k.cl_arrival_mode AS mode_ref, k.cl_shipment_product AS product,
       COUNT(*) AS delivered
  FROM complete k
 GROUP BY k.cl_arrival_place, k.cl_arrival_mode, k.cl_shipment_product
 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;
